Beta Bionics is a medical technology company developing diabetes management solutions, including the iLet Bionic Pancreas. The Enterprise Applications Developer builds, enhances, tests, deploys, and supports business applications, integrations, data workflows, Salesforce solutions, and automation while collaborating with technical and business stakeholders.
Biotechnology
Medical Device
Diabetes
Responsibilities
Develop, enhance, test, deploy, and maintain business applications, scripts, services, APIs, and automation using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and other approved technologies under the guidance of senior team members
Write clean, reusable, testable code and participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, testing, release activities, documentation, and production support
Apply development, security, data quality, change control, source control, and deployment standards established by IT platform owners and senior technical team members
Work with business analysts and users to clarify requirements, translate them into maintainable solutions, and support user acceptance testing and adoption
Build and support integrations among enterprise applications, Salesforce and other SaaS platforms, cloud services, databases, and external partners using REST APIs, web services, middleware, and event-driven patterns
Develop and support Salesforce enhancements and connected solutions using declarative tools and, based on experience, technologies such as Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, SOQL/SOSL, and platform APIs
Support enterprise platforms through enhancements, integrations, data updates, troubleshooting, testing, releases, monitoring, and documentation
Develop and support data extraction, transformation, validation, loading, and reconciliation processes for operational and reporting needs
Build workflow automations that reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and streamline business processes across Salesforce and other systems
Assist with AI-enabled and agentic solutions, including integration, testing, prompt and workflow configuration, monitoring, documentation, and appropriate human oversight
Collaborate with technical and business team members to estimate, prioritize, and deliver enhancements, fixes, integrations, and automation initiatives
Troubleshoot application, Salesforce, integration, data, and automation issues; document findings and escalate complex problems when appropriate
Maintain technical documentation, test evidence, deployment notes, support procedures, and knowledge articles
Continue building knowledge across Python, modern application development, cloud services, APIs, data engineering, Salesforce, automation, and secure software development practices
Follow company standards for security, privacy, least privilege, data handling, change control, validation, documentation, and production support
Support compliance and audit activities related to HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, SOX, internal IT controls, and applicable quality or regulatory requirements
Ensure assigned solutions are tested, documented, auditable, reliable, and supportable
While performing the duties of this job, the incumbent is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with co-workers
This position requires travel depending upon business needs

Required
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
1-3 years of professional software development, application development, internship, or comparable hands-on experience
Foundational experience with Python and at least one additional web or application development language, preferably JavaScript or TypeScript
Understanding of REST APIs, web services, data integrations, and common application integration concepts
Working knowledge of SQL, relational data concepts, data quality, and basic ETL or data processing workflows
Familiarity with Git, testing, source control, deployment processes, and modern software development practices
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and willingness to learn
Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
This position requires travel depending upon business needs
Irvine, CA or San Diego, CA. This is an in-office position
Preferred
Experience developing, configuring, or supporting Salesforce using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, SOQL/SOSL, platform APIs, permission models, or declarative tools
Salesforce Platform Developer I, Administrator, Platform App Builder, or another relevant Salesforce certification
Experience with Salesforce Health Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Rootstock, ComplianceQuest, MuleSoft, or other Salesforce ecosystem products
Experience building Salesforce integrations or working with CI/CD and release management tools for Salesforce
Experience with AWS or Azure services, serverless applications, cloud databases, or integration platforms
Experience with front-end development, ETL/ELT tools, data visualization, workflow automation, or intelligent document processing
Exposure to AI, large language models, retrieval systems, prompt and workflow design, or agentic automation
Experience working in healthcare, medical device, life sciences, or another regulated industry
